instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.

arguments.note: The charger is in front of the right arm. I will turn the gripper downward before approaching its upper body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger lies flat with its pins toward the near edge. I will first obtain a top-down grasp on the body, leaving the pins clear.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The top-down view places the charger forward and right of the grasp point. I will approach above its body and align the jaws with its sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is slightly left of the approach, and its body angle requires the opposite jaw rotation. I will correct the alignment before descending.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws now align with the charger sides. I will lower to just above its body to refine the grasp position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: At the lower viewpoint the body remains to the right and nearer than the jaw centre. I will shift laterally while retaining clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is now between the open jaws. I will lower toward the body and inspect before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The body is slightly right of the jaw centre. I will make a small centring correction at the current grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger body is centred between the jaws, with its pins clear below. I will close the gripper to secure it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: I will lift slightly to check whether the charger is held before transporting it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger stayed on the table, so the previous closure was above it. I will reopen and return to the approach height for a lower grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The closure point was toward the back end of the body. I will move toward its middle and slightly lower before trying again.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The body overlaps the jaw closure region now. I will lower another five millimetres to engage its sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are now at the body height. I will close around the charger.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The gripper stopped on the charger body. I will lift it clear of the table and verify the pin orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger lifted successfully, with the pins projecting toward the near side. I will tilt it halfway toward a pins-down insertion posture.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger remains secure during the tilt. I will finish turning its pins downward while clear of the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 37 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The capped motion stopped at a partial tilt. I will complete the pins-down orientation from the measured pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 22 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The charger is upright with its pins down. I will carry it leftward in free space toward the power strip.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The strip lies farther left. I will continue the overhead transfer while keeping the charger well above the sockets.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 24 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The carrying wrist cannot see the sockets below the charger. I will angle the idle wrist downward to inspect alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip is at the edge of the idle wrist view. I will raise and shift that camera to see the plug and sockets together.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 17 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The idle wrist shows the upright charger above the right-hand socket group. I will lower toward it while keeping the pins clear for alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is still above the socket face. I will reduce the remaining vertical gap before making millimetre-scale insertion corrections.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The socket pair appears beneath the charger. I will descend six millimetres and check for contact or lateral displacement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger hides its pins from the current inspection angle. I will move the idle camera sideways to expose the insertion gap.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The inspection target moved to the image edge. I will centre the camera laterally while keeping it safely above the working arm.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The new view shows the charger aligned over the end socket. I will lower five millimetres, checking that the strip stays still.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The strip remains stationary and the arm followed the small descent. I will continue downward by another five millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger remains upright over the socket without shifting the strip. I will advance another small insertion increment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The socket face is coming into view below the held body. I will continue the controlled descent by four millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The body remains upright and no lateral movement is visible. I will lower four millimetres more while watching the socket edge.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The exposed socket slots appear offset from the charger centre. I will lift slightly to clear the pins before correcting alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger was between socket groups. With the pins lifted, I will align it with the rightmost pair of slots.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The rightmost slots are now directly beneath the charger, with a small lateral offset. I will centre by three millimetres and lower slightly.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The paired slots are centred below the charger. I will advance four millimetres into the socket.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The slots are centred laterally but appear slightly nearer than the pins. I will correct toward the near side by five millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is centred over the slot pair after the fore-aft correction. I will lower another four millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The pins have reached the socket face but the body has not seated. I will make a three-millimetre fore-aft alignment correction without pressing farther down.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The corrected pins overlap the socket openings. I will test seating with a three-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The visible pin gap is nearly closed. I will lower three millimetres to seat the charger body against the socket.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: A narrow gap remains under the body. I will make one more three-millimetre seating motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is close to flush with the strip and remains upright. I will finish with a three-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger body now appears seated against the strip. I will release it without moving the arm, then verify that it remains upright.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The released charger remains upright on the strip. I will withdraw the open jaws gently away from it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger remains standing in the end socket after withdrawal. I will begin returning the right arm through clear space.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The right arm is clear of the strip. I will return its grasp point to its starting position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 30 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The right arm is within its home tolerance and the charger remains stable. I will return the inspection arm to its original position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The inspection arm has reached its original position. I will restore its starting orientation to complete the required return home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
